fusions.name: Scent Lunge
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away for a bite that deals 13 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: End of the Chase
fusions.desc: Seizes an enemy at or below 25% health for 22 damage, consuming every affliction you have on it and adding 1.4 times their remaining damage. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Decoy Run
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. While it lasts, a hound runs beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lurcher at Heel
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded lurcher that runs beside you, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites is slowed by 20% for 2 seconds.
